name: UGC Product Video
description: Create a native-audio Seedance 2.5 testimonial, then turn its spoken words into stable captions, restrained motion graphics, and an exact branded close.

props.text: One take. Native voice. A polished social finish.
🔑 Writing and caption transcription use OpenAI. The sample uses Seedance 2.5 on AtlasCloud with native audio; choose it below or select another compatible model.
Pick the promise before touching footage. A UGC hook should create curiosity without making a claim the product cannot support.
Image 1 anchors the creator and room. Image 2 anchors only the product. Seedance 2.5 generates voice and lip movement with the picture, then permits the cup on screen only from 4.5 to 7 seconds.

props.label: Generating voice, lip-sync, and motion together…
Transcribing the clip and rendering the finish…

props.text: Captions follow the generated audio and stay reviewable. Watch once with sound, once muted, and check every highlighted word before publishing.

data.string: Use @Image1 only for the creator identity, face, hair, wardrobe, room, and natural skin texture. Use @Image2 only for the product silhouette, muted-olive finish, charcoal lid, and proportions. Do not transfer the product image background. Product: {{ product }}. Create one continuous 15-second vertical 9:16 front-camera phone testimonial. Preserve fine facial asymmetry, small spontaneous blinks, tiny gaze corrections, breathing, imperfect handheld movement, slight autofocus and exposure breathing, and mild phone compression. [0.0-4.5s] Chest-up creator alone. No product or hands visible. She begins the exact dialogue below with mild surprise. [4.5-7.0s] Without cutting away from her face, she briefly lifts the @Image2 product from below frame into the lower-right corner, never blocking her face, then lowers it completely out of frame at 7.0s. [7.0-15.0s] Keep the camera on her face with the product and hands fully out of frame through the final smile. Exact dialogue: {{ script }} No extra words. Generate picture, voice, and lip-sync together in one pass. Natural adult female voice, clear conversational English, warm mid-register, unstaged creator cadence, subtle room tone. No music, voice-over, extra speakers, subtitles, on-screen text, logos, jump cuts, cutaways, beauty-filter skin, waxy texture, rigid posture, repetitive mouth motion, exaggerated expressions, product before 4.5s, product after 7.0s, product morphing, or compositing seams.

workflows.name: Brand a UGC Product Video
workflows.description: Turn one continuous vertical creator clip into a polished branded reel. The workflow extracts the native audio, transcribes it with word timestamps, groups the words into short animated phrases, builds an editable NodeTool timeline with MORROW motion graphics, and renders the finished video.

data.comment:
# Brand a UGC Product Video

Drop in one continuous, native-audio vertical creator clip. The workflow transcribes the clip, groups the spoken words into 3–5 word phrases, and builds a reusable editable timeline with word highlighting, stable frame-snapped phrases, a MORROW opening bug, a cup-callout bracket, and an animated closing lockup.

**Pipeline:** Creator clip → Native audio → Word timestamps → Motion-design timeline → Final reel

**Style:** Ivory `#F6F4EC`, sage `#C0D28C`, forest `#14241E`. `Polished` adds a soft caption plate; `Minimal` keeps only type and outline.
